Commun"},"printPublicationDate":"2020-01-01"},"pubYear":"2020","pageInfo":"tgaa051","abstractText":"Cooperative interactions between the amygdala and hippocampus are widely regarded as critical for overnight emotional processing of waking experiences, but direct support from the human brain for such a dialog is absent. Using overnight intracranial recordings in 4 presurgical epilepsy patients (3 female), we discovered ripples within human amygdala during nonrapid eye movement (NREM) sleep, a brain state known to contribute to affective processing. Like hippocampal ripples, amygdala ripples are associated with sharp waves, linked to sleep spindles, and tend to co-occur with their hippocampal counterparts. Moreover, sharp waves and ripples are temporally linked across the 2 brain structures, with amygdala ripples occurring during hippocampal sharp waves and <i>vice versa</i>. Combined with further evidence of interregional sharp-wave and spindle synchronization, these findings offer a potential physiological substrate for the NREM-sleep-dependent consolidation and regulation of emotional experiences.","affiliation":"Department of Epileptology, University of Bonn, Bonn 53127, Germany.","publicationStatus":"ppublish","language":"eng","pubModel":"Print-Electronic","pubTypeList":{"pubType":["research-article","Journal Article"]},"grantsList":{"grant":[{"agency":"German Research Foundation","grantId":"FE366/9-1","orderIn":0},{"agency":"Wellcome Trust","acronym":"WT","grantId":"107672/Z/15/Z","orderIn":0},{"agency":"Wellcome Trust","acronym":"WT_","orderIn":0}]},"keywordList":{"keyword":["Hippocampus","Amygdala","Sharp Waves","Ripples","Nrem Sleep"]},"fullTextUrlList":{"fullTextUrl":[{"availability":"Subscription required","availabilityCode":"S","documentStyle":"doi","site":"DOI","url":"https://doi.org/10.1093/texcom/tgaa051"},{"availability":"Open access","availabilityCode":"OA","documentStyle":"html","site":"Europe_PMC","url":"https://europepmc.org/articles/PMC7521160"},{"availability":"Open access","availabilityCode":"OA","documentStyle":"pdf","site":"Europe_PMC","url":"https://europepmc.org/articles/PMC7521160?pdf=render"}]},"commentCorrectionList":{"commentCorrection":[{"source":"PPR","id":"PPR108126","type":"Preprint in","note":"CrossRef Pre-print loader","orderIn":10002}]},"isOpenAccess":"Y","inEPMC":"Y","inPMC":"Y","citedByCount":17,"hasReferences":"Y","hasTextMinedTerms":"Y","hasDbCrossReferences":"N","hasPDF":"Y","hasBook":"N","hasSuppl":"Y","hasLabsLinks":"N","hasData":"Y","license":"cc by","authMan":"N","epmcAuthMan":"N","nihAuthMan":"N","hasTMAccessionNumbers":"N","dateOfCreation":"2020-10-05","dateOfRevision":"2024-08-11","electronicPublicationDate":"2020-08-20","firstPublicationDate":"2020-08-20","firstIndexDate":"2020-10-16","fullTextReceivedDate":"2025-02-04","hasEvaluations":"N"}]}}
